lines: Before a custom ride starts, Your ride shows what it will ask of you, right beside the settings.
GCN's thirty-minute HIIT reads thirty minutes, its resistance profile from start to finish: seventeen bars, warm-up to cool-down.
Then the facts: eight thirty-second efforts, four minutes under load, level twenty-four at the peak, about a hundred and fifty-four watts and two hundred and seventy-six kilocalories.
Change anything, and Your ride follows at once. Remove a round: twenty-six thirty.
Flat at level twelve reads level twelve throughout: about two hundred and five watts, with no time under load.

Ride along to a video parks the YouTube preview at your offset. Scrub past the intro, use the video's current time, and Your ride reads synced from twelve seconds. A link that is not YouTube's is caught at once.
Your ride, from a phone to the full screen.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
